headline: One phone, two names on Google: JM Landscaping INC and Jose Mateo Landscaping.
summary: This is a real independent Lakeside landscape, hardscape, and tree crew. The site covers pavers, concrete, retaining walls, artificial grass, fencing, irrigation, cleanups, tree work, and stump removal, and talks about over two decades of experience. On Google Maps, your JM Landscaping INC profile is live at 5.0 stars, category Landscaper, and links to jmlandscapingincca.com. A second Google listing called Jose Mateo Landscaping rings the same (619) 313-1279, shows 4.0 stars, and has no website on it. MapQuest, Nextdoor, and Manta still print Jose Mateo Landscaping at 9634 Acacia St, while the site prints only Lakeside, CA. A neighbor can land on either name and wonder if it is the same crew.

signals.note: You show up for landscaping in Lakeside. Google Maps shows JM Landscaping INC, Landscaper, Open, at 5.0 stars, with your website and phone on the card. Your site also carries a write-a-review link that opens that same Google profile. A neighbor looking for pavers, a retaining wall, or a cleanup can find you.
signals.next: Keep sending happy customers that review link. A short thank you under new reviews goes a long way with neighbors.

signals.note: The number (619) 313-1279 is the same on the site, both Google listings, MapQuest, and Nextdoor. info@jmlandscapingincca.com sits in clear text in the Get In Touch block on the site. One phone and one inbox is exactly right.
signals.next: Keep (619) 313-1279 and info@jmlandscapingincca.com on every listing. Copy them the same morning if either ever changes.

signals.note: The site prints Monday through Friday 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM at the top and in the footer. Your JM Landscaping INC profile on Google shows Monday 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. The Jose Mateo Landscaping listing shows Monday 7:30 AM to 5 PM. A neighbor calling late in the afternoon can get two different answers.
signals.next: Pick the real closing time and put it on the site and the JM Landscaping INC profile the same day.

signals.note: The site has a gallery and a link to your Instagram, jm_landscaping_inc. Patios, walls, and turf are the kind of work that sells itself in pictures.
signals.next: Add a few fresh jobs each season to the gallery and to your Google profile so both look like this year.

signals.note: jmlandscapingincca.com loads and belongs to you. Every service has its own card, and the phone, inbox, and weekday hours are all on the page. The footer already says 2026. The one thing missing is a street: the Get In Touch block prints only Lakeside, CA.
signals.next: Keep the site as it is. Add one line to Get In Touch with the address or service area you want neighbors to see.

signals.note: Phone lines up everywhere. The name does not. Google has JM Landscaping INC with your website, and a second listing, Jose Mateo Landscaping, with the same phone, 4.0 stars, and no website. MapQuest, Nextdoor, Manta, and Giftly print Jose Mateo Landscaping at 9634 Acacia St, Lakeside. MapQuest still links jose-mateo-landscaping.business.site, which no longer opens. Two names for one crew is how a neighbor wonders if they found the right door.
signals.next: If Jose Mateo Landscaping is the older card for the same crew, claim it and either add jmlandscapingincca.com to it or ask Google to fold it into the JM Landscaping INC profile. Then use one name and one line, for example JM Landscaping INC, Lakeside, CA, on every listing.
